tonight.headline: Tuten is cleared, so the Friday rule says start him
body: Bad news first: Isaiah Likely did not practise Friday (groin), and you carry no other tight end. He has no designation and Harbaugh calls it 'minor'. If he is inactive at 13:55 Sunday the TE slot scores zero. Nothing on your bench can fill it, and the only droppable seats then are Jacobs and Golden. Jonathan Taylor's 6.7 is final, and Indianapolis released Daniel Jones today. Anthony Richardson starts from Week 12.

Tuten went limited Friday and is off Jacksonville's final report, so the morning's rule resolves: start him. Rice stays on the bench. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. ESPN has you at 118.1 to 111.9 and 53%.

case.body: KEI returns start Lawrence (18.6), Parker Washington (15.3) and Skattebo (14.5) at 15:25 in Jacksonville–New York, the same game as your Tuten and Likely, plus Emmett Johnson (20.3) starting for Kansas City with Walker out (atozsports). A Likely zero would decide it.

case.body: Likely inactive at 13:55: 13.2 projected points become zero, and there is no fallback.
